function.description: Resolve a token symbol/name to its exact on-chain contract address(es) + decimals per chain (the canonical EVM token resolver). Use BEFORE any swap or bridge. It covers KHALANI-REGISTERED CHAINS ONLY, and that set is dynamic - list it with `khalani__chains_list` rather than assuming it. App-local chains such as Robinhood Chain (4663) are NOT resolvable here; there use `dexscreener__pairs_search` (symbol to address lookup on the chain slug), `WalletTrackToken` (save a token so Vex tracks it on app-local chains, action:"list" for the tracked set), or `WalletBalances` (the tokens the wallet actually holds).
function.name: TokenFind

chainIds.description: Comma-separated chain IDs or aliases. Accepts either a comma-separated string ("1,8453") or an array of strings (["1","8453"]) — the two are equivalent.
